title: Weekend signups
prompt: Return the name (column: name) of users who signed up on a Saturday or Sunday, using strftime('%w', signup_date) where '0' means Sunday and '6' means Saturday.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, signup_date TEXT); INSERT INTO users VALUES (1,'Zane Holt','2024-03-02'),(2,'Amy Osei','2024-03-04'),(3,'Blake Ross','2024-03-09'),(4,'Cora Vail','2024-03-06'),(5,'Diego Marsh','2024-03-03'),(6,'Elle Trent','2024-03-08');
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE strftime('%w', signup_date) IN ('0','6');
